objective: Improve same-image target-conditioned state learning before sequence training.

training.loss: Answer and EOS token cross entropy; same trainer and prompts.

evaluation.policy: Final checkpoint only; no intermediate selection; same fixed-answer JSON interface.
evaluation.all_targets_dev: 112 all-target dev questions on 12 original images
evaluation.current_dev: 104 original current-only dev questions; deduplicate matching pixels and prompts in comparisons
evaluation.text_dev: 208 original text dev questions; deduplicate matching prompts in comparisons

held_out: Original 130 visual test cases unused while gates remain unstable.
limitations: Concentrated training changes task mixture and exposure; no equal-budget mixed-replay control.
No text or current-only training replay in this run; retention must be evaluated explicitly.
Training-set success is not visual generalization or H1 completion; no characters, fonts, or sequence learning.

illustrative_case.selection: First mixed-state horizontal training scene; show all targets and both wordings regardless of final success. Supplemental illustration, not a metric.
